title: The Winter Pass
tagline: Cross the mountains and return before the snow closes the road.
intro: The village granary burned at the end of autumn. The only grain left lies across the mountains, at the monastery of Highcrest. A small company must fetch it and return before the first snowfall seals the pass for months.
goal: Bring the grain back from Highcrest monastery before the snow closes the pass.
questions: What destroyed the granary, and whom does the village blame?
Why won't the monastery simply hand over the grain?
What do people say about the pass that nobody dares say aloud?
Who in the village would rather see the company fail?
What promise did the company make to the village before leaving?
difficulties: The snow will come earlier than expected
The monks want something in return
Bandits hold the old bridge
Someone in the village is sabotaging the expedition
Only one person in the company knows the way
The load is too heavy to return quickly
desires: Prove I am not a coward
Repay a debt to the village
Win back the respect I lost
Learn what happened to the one who crossed and never came back

challenges.title: Convince the council
challenges.text: The village must lend mules and supplies it can barely spare.

challenges.title: The old bridge
challenges.text: It is guarded, or rotten, or both.

challenges.title: The storm
challenges.text: Shelter and lose days, or press on blind.

challenges.title: Bargain with the abbot
challenges.text: The monastery has mouths to feed too.

challenges.title: An injury on the road
challenges.text: Someone gets hurt and slows everyone down.

challenges.title: The loaded return
challenges.text: Slower, wearier, and racing the weather.

challenges.title: The bandits
challenges.text: They want the grain, or they want someone in the company.

challenges.title: The last night
challenges.text: One day from home, something changes everything.

title: Meridian Station
tagline: Keep an orbital station alive until relief arrives.
intro: Meridian Station orbits a gas giant months away from any port. The relief ship has just announced a forty-day delay, and the station's systems were never meant to last that long. The crew has to hold on.
goal: Keep Meridian Station's crew alive until relief arrives.
questions: What is the station researching that the company cares so much about?
Why is the relief ship late?
Which part of the station does nobody visit?
Who aboard has orders the others don't know about?
What does the crew swear to each other when the delay is announced?
difficulties: The air recycler fails every few days
The company puts the data before the crew
A storm on the planet cuts communications
The rations don't add up
Someone aboard is not on the manifest
The autopilot has plans of its own
desires: Make the company pay for this
Finally be the one who decides
Make sure nobody learns what I did

challenges.title: Rationing
challenges.text: Decide who gets what when there isn't enough.

challenges.title: Fix the recycler
challenges.text: Slow, dangerous work outside the hull.

challenges.title: Restore contact
challenges.text: The antenna must be aligned mid-storm.

challenges.title: The sealed module
challenges.text: Something, or someone, is inside.

challenges.title: Mutiny
challenges.text: Part of the crew wants to abandon the station.

challenges.title: Company orders
challenges.text: A message arrives that changes everything.

challenges.title: Decaying orbit
challenges.text: The station begins falling toward the planet.

challenges.title: Relief arrives
challenges.text: But there isn't room for everyone.

title: The House on Almond Street
tagline: A family, a cheap house and something that already lived there.
intro: The house was half price and nobody asked why. Three weeks after moving in, the youngest daughter has stopped sleeping, the dog won't go upstairs and drawings nobody made keep appearing in the basement. The family and those around them must find out what's in the house and drive it out, or get out themselves, before the night that marks forty years since what happened.
goal: Save the family from what lives in the house on Almond Street.
questions: What happened in the house forty years ago?
Why can't the family simply leave?
What was the first thing the house took from them?
Who in the neighbourhood knows more than they say?
What shape does it take when it finally shows itself?
difficulties: The youngest daughter is its target
Nobody outside believes what's happening
The mortgage makes leaving impossible
The thing imitates familiar voices
One of the parents starts defending the house
The anniversary is three nights away
concepts: Grandfather who grew up in the neighbourhood
desires: That my daughter sleeps peacefully again
Not lose the house I fought so hard for
Finish what I didn't finish forty years ago

challenges.title: The first night together
challenges.text: Everyone decides to sleep in the living room. Not everyone will wake up there.

challenges.title: The basement drawings
challenges.text: Someone has to go down and understand what they show.

challenges.title: The neighbour
challenges.text: She knows what happened, but making her talk has a price.

challenges.title: The sleepwalking girl
challenges.text: She walks toward a part of the house that isn't on the plans.

challenges.title: The blessing
challenges.text: The priest agrees to come; the house doesn't agree to him.

challenges.title: The anniversary
challenges.text: At midnight, what happened forty years ago happens again.

challenges.title: The other family
challenges.text: The names of the previous owners appear on the walls.

challenges.title: Out the front door
challenges.text: It seems easy until you try.

title: Camp Black Lake, 1986
tagline: Last weekend of summer. Someone doesn't want them to leave.
intro: The camp closes on Monday. The counsellors have stayed behind to pack up and say goodbye in style. But the radio is dead, the boat is gone and one of them hasn't come back from the woods. There's a story told by the campfire every year, and tonight it starts coming true.
goal: Survive until the bus arrives on Monday morning.
questions: What story is told by the campfire every summer?
What did some of them do last summer that nobody knows?
Why can't they walk out to the road?
Who in town had reason to hate the camp?
What is the figure in the woods wearing?
difficulties: The radio has been sabotaged
The woods are huge and all look the same
There's a summer storm
Nobody would believe them if they called
Someone in the group is helping it
The camp owner is hiding something
concepts: Weird girl who reads horror novels
Local kid who supplies the beer
desires: That nobody finds out about last summer
That my father doesn't lose the camp
Finally know if the story was true

challenges.title: The disappearance
challenges.text: One of them hasn't come back and someone must go looking.

challenges.title: The warden's cabin
challenges.text: There's a phone. There's something else too.

challenges.title: The lake
challenges.text: The far shore is the road. The boat is gone.

challenges.title: The lights go out
challenges.text: The generator is in the furthest shed.

challenges.title: The confession
challenges.text: One of them knows why this is happening.

challenges.title: Splitting up
challenges.text: Never a good idea, and now the only one.

challenges.title: The trap
challenges.text: It has to be lured somewhere.

challenges.title: Dawn
challenges.text: Just hold on until the bus horn sounds.

title: The Villaruz Shaft, 1923
tagline: An Asturian mine reaches a depth that shouldn't exist.
intro: The miners of Villaruz struck a gallery of smooth stone spiralling down beyond the reach of any sounding line. Since then, the whole town dreams the same dream, the chief engineer has locked himself in his house and the Cantabrian tides come in late. The feast of Our Lady of Carmel is in four days, and the shaft seems to be waiting for it.
goal: Seal the Villaruz shaft before the night of the feast.
questions: What did the miners find at the end of the smooth gallery?
What has the whole town dreamed since?
Who in Villaruz has waited generations for this?
Why does the mining company refuse to close the mine?
What has stopped working properly near the shaft?
difficulties: The mining company has the Civil Guard on its side
Each descent costs a memory
The chief engineer refuses to talk
The town's dynamiters have vanished
Time runs slower inside the mine
Some townsfolk want the shaft opened
desires: That my family never learns my part in this
Destroy it even if it costs my life
Publish the discovery of the century
That the town goes on existing

challenges.title: The engineer's house
challenges.text: He hasn't left in weeks and he has the plans.

challenges.title: The smooth gallery
challenges.text: Someone must go down and see, at least once.

challenges.title: The dynamite
challenges.text: It's in the company magazine, under guard.

challenges.title: The dream
challenges.text: Everyone dreams the same tonight, and in the dream something can be done.

challenges.title: The procession
challenges.text: The town walks to the mine with candles.

challenges.title: The casino library
challenges.text: An old book of the marquis describes the spiral.

challenges.title: The tide
challenges.text: The sea has withdrawn and the seabed bears the same spiral.

challenges.title: Seal it
challenges.text: Someone has to stay to light the fuse.

title: The Esperanza Expedition, 1931
tagline: An Antarctic expedition finds a city beneath the ice.
intro: The ship Esperanza has been anchored in the ice bay for three months while the expedition drills the glacier. Yesterday the probe broke through the ice and fell into emptiness. Cameras lowered down the hole show streets, stairways and arches no human hand could have carved. The austral winter is about to close the sea.
goal: Get home before the ice closes the bay, bringing nothing back with you.
questions: Who funds the expedition, and what do they hope to find?
What do the photographs under the ice show?
Why is there an abandoned camp older than yours?
What happened to the first man who went down?
What has happened to the dogs?
difficulties: The sponsor demands a sample
The radio picks up only a melody
The captain wants to sail now, with or without everyone
Something has come up the hole
The compasses point toward the city
One of the scientists doesn't want to go back
desires: That my name goes down in history
Pay off my debts to the sponsor

challenges.title: The descent
challenges.text: Someone has to go down the rope.

challenges.title: The sample
challenges.text: The sponsor wants it; the city won't let it go.

challenges.title: The old camp
challenges.text: The diaries of the earlier camp end abruptly.

challenges.title: The storm
challenges.text: Three days without leaving the tents.

challenges.title: What came up
challenges.text: Something has climbed out of the hole and is among them.

challenges.title: The flight
challenges.text: From the seaplane, the whole city can be seen.

challenges.title: The captain
challenges.text: He must be persuaded to wait, or to leave.

challenges.title: The bay closes
challenges.text: Last chance to sail.

title: The Valcárcel Inheritance
tagline: A family, a crumbling house and a curse that collects every generation.
intro: Don Honorio Valcárcel is dead, and his will gathers the whole family at the manor for nine nights of mourning. It is said that no Valcárcel firstborn has reached thirty since an ancestor walled his wife up in the east wing. The heir turns thirty in nine days.
goal: Break the Valcárcel curse before the heir turns thirty.
questions: What did the ancestor really do to his wife?
What does Don Honorio's will demand?
Who in the family profits if the curse is fulfilled?
What can be heard in the east wing at night?
What secret do the servants keep?
difficulties: The family hate each other
The notary reads a new clause each night
The house is falling apart
Nobody may leave the manor during mourning
The heir doesn't want to be saved
The walled-up wife wants something in return
concepts: Elder sister who should have inherited
desires: Know who my real father was
That the dead woman finally rests

challenges.title: The reading of the will
challenges.text: Each clause sets the family against itself.

challenges.title: The east wing
challenges.text: That door hasn't been opened in eighty years.

challenges.title: The mourning dinner
challenges.text: The whole county will come to watch the family.

challenges.title: The crypt
challenges.text: There's a nameless niche, and it's empty.

challenges.title: The portrait
challenges.text: The walled-up wife was painted holding something.

challenges.title: The heir falls ill
challenges.text: He coughs blood on the seventh night, like all before him.

challenges.title: The servants' confession
challenges.text: Their grandmothers helped wall her up.

challenges.title: The ninth night
challenges.text: The curse comes to collect.

title: The Pilgrimage of Saint Ciriaco
tagline: A village, a festival and an outsider who shouldn't be there.
intro: Every seven years, the village of Valdeoscuro climbs to the hermitage of Saint Ciriaco on the last night of August. This year there are outsiders: a teacher, an ethnographer, the granddaughter of a neighbour who died in spring. The villagers are kind. Too kind. And someone has tied a red ribbon to the granddaughter's door.
goal: Get the granddaughter out of the valley before the pilgrimage ends.
questions: What is done at the hermitage every seven years?
Why was this year's harvest so good?
What happened to the outsiders seven years ago?
Who in the village disagrees with the custom?
What exactly does Saint Ciriaco ask for?
difficulties: The roads close during the festival
The constable is from the village
The granddaughter doesn't want to leave
The villagers take turns keeping watch
Nobody has signal
The custom, somehow, works
desires: Know what happened to my brother seven years ago

challenges.title: The welcome dinner
challenges.text: The whole village watches the outsiders.

challenges.title: The red ribbon
challenges.text: What it means and whom it marks must be found out.

challenges.title: The road
challenges.text: The only working car belongs to the mayor.

challenges.title: The parish archive
challenges.text: The death registers of every seventh year.

challenges.title: Bonfire night
challenges.text: The whole village dances and nobody may be absent.

challenges.title: The hill
challenges.text: The path to the hermitage is the only one out of the valley.

challenges.title: The custom
challenges.text: Someone must take her place.

challenges.title: The pilgrimage
challenges.text: At dawn, the procession climbs.

title: Rain over Barcelona, 1947
tagline: A witness, a bought city and five days until the trial.
intro: Emilio Soler, accountant to the most powerful black marketeer on the docks, has decided to testify. The trial is on Monday. Until then someone has to keep him alive in a city where the police, the press and half the bars are paid by the same man. It has been raining for three days and shows no sign of stopping.
goal: Keep Emilio Soler alive until he testifies on Monday.
questions: What exactly does Emilio Soler know?
Why has he decided to talk now?
Who is the man from the docks, and whom has he bought?
What is each of you to Soler?
Who has paid for the trial to go wrong?
difficulties: The police are bought
Soler drinks and talks too much
There's a price on his head
The judge is in debt
The press wants blood
Someone in the group works for the other side
desires: See the man from the docks fall
That my name never comes up at the trial
Protect my family from what Soler might say

challenges.title: The safe house
challenges.text: A safe place must be found. There isn't one.

challenges.title: The raid
challenges.text: The police are coming for him tonight.

challenges.title: Blackmail
challenges.text: Someone has photos of one of you.

challenges.title: The Liceu
challenges.text: Soler insists on going to the opera, and the man from the docks will be there.

challenges.title: The transfer
challenges.text: The city must be crossed at night.

challenges.title: The betrayal
challenges.text: Someone has said where he is.

challenges.title: The press
challenges.text: A reporter is about to publish everything.

challenges.title: The courthouse
challenges.text: Reaching the courtroom is the hardest part.

title: The Santa Muerte Stagecoach
tagline: A five-day journey through a desert where the dead won't lie still.
intro: The stagecoach leaves Tres Cruces for Santa Muerte with six passengers and a sealed coffin nobody wants to open. Some pay handsomely for the coffin to arrive, others pay better for it not to. Along the way there are raiders, bandits, a ghost town and the grave of a man who swore he'd come back.
goal: Deliver the sealed coffin to Santa Muerte without opening it.
questions: Who is inside the coffin?
Who pays for it to arrive, and who for it not to?
What did the man in the grave swear before he died?
What's said about the ghost town of Redemption?
What ties each of you to Santa Muerte?
difficulties: The coffin whispers at night
A gang is following the coach
The horses refuse to pass certain places
Water is scarce
One passenger lied about who they are
The driver knows the road too well
desires: That the dead man stays dead
Reach Santa Muerte and start over

challenges.title: Santa Muerte

title: The Liceu Job
tagline: A gala, a jewel and a crew that betrayed itself once already.
intro: Five years ago the crew broke up after a job went wrong and someone walked off with everything. Now an anonymous client brings them back together to steal the Tear of Seville during the Liceu opera house's reopening gala. The pay is enough to retire on. The trust isn't.
goal: Steal the Tear of Seville during the gala and all get out together.
questions: What went wrong five years ago, and whom do they blame?
Who is the anonymous client?
Why is the Tear worth more than it seems?

What will each of you do with your cut?

An inspector is on their trail
The original plan belonged to someone who's gone

Someone in the crew has a score to settle with another
The gala is being broadcast on TV
desires: Pay a debt to someone who doesn't forgive

challenges.text: Las Ramblas are packed with people and police.

title: Seeds
tagline: Carry the last living harvest across a dry country.
intro: The settlement of La Vega survives on seeds from the old seed bank. But the well has dried up, and the only place with water to plant is two hundred kilometres away, across militia land. A group must carry the seeds there before the sowing season ends.
goal: Get the seeds to the river valley before the sowing season ends.
questions: What happened to the old world, according to those who remember?
Who controls the land between La Vega and the river?
Why can't the seeds be planted just anywhere?

The militia takes its toll in flesh

The valley may not exist

desires: Be forgiven for having been militia
Find my people in the valley
